response.justification: The candidate lacks any demonstrable C++ experience on Windows platforms, fixed income or capital markets domain knowledge, and SQL Server/Oracle expertise — all mandatory requirements. Their career is centered on web, mobile, and open-source tools using TypeScript, DLang, and Node.js, with no evidence of financial systems development or Windows-based C++ work.
strengths: Strong full-stack and open-source development experience
Demonstrated expertise in CI/CD, testing, and dev-ops practices
Excellent communication skills evidenced by workshops and public talks
concerns: No professional C++ experience on Windows platform as required
No exposure to fixed income, capital markets, or investment banking domains
SQL experience listed but no evidence of SQL Server or Oracle usage
